title: Pretraining-budget robustness of the vocabulary result: V2 V4k and V2 V24k at 2x steps
purpose: The V2 result (smaller natural-corpus vocabulary is better) is tied to a 2,400-step pretraining budget; the rare-token mechanism predicts that a larger budget narrows the gap. Rerun the two ends of the V2 series with 4,800 steps.

preregistered_predictions.P-B1: V24k gains more from doubling the budget than V4k (rare-token starvation eases): (B24k - V2 V24k) exceeds (B4k - V2 V4k) by at least 3 pp exact.
preregistered_predictions.P-B2: V4k still beats V24k at 4,800 steps (gap > 5 pp exact, adopted): the vocabulary conclusion is robust to a 2x budget.
preregistered_predictions.decision_rule: Per-seed exact McNemar B4k vs B24k, and each vs its 2,400-step counterpart; Stouffer; Holm over 4 contrasts x 3 metrics; sign rule.
